identity.name: enrich_centreline
identity.description: Single-phase ENRICHER: proximity-joins parcels.geom against toronto_centreline (the §11 9-CTE chain, 20 m ST_DWithin over geography) and writes is_corner_lot / is_through_lot / primary_frontage_street_name / abuts_laneway + the producer lineage stamp in ONE set-based join UPDATE behind a 5-column IS DISTINCT FROM guard. The legacy three-mode version-skip gate (WF2 P11-1) is PORTED VERBATIM (plan D1 = (a)): the contract_read hook resolves full / incremental / skip from the producer version, the step's own last stamped version and the stale-parcel count; the pass runs the unscoped build, the stale-scoped build, or nothing.

why_lock.text: L4b re-derived: Spec 62's 66 collided with enrich_permits; 64 is the free sibling of load_centreline = 63. Kept textually in the frozen shell per Spec 122 §5.4 so the registry loop (src/tests/pipeline-advisory-lock.infra.test.ts) stays green across the conversion.

guard_columns_why.text: The verbatim 5-disjunct guard, legacy UPDATE_SQL :261-265 (abuts_laneway joined it with Spec 65 Phase 3 / #431-FU2). The lineage stamp is INSIDE the guard: it is the producer's content-hash source_dataset_version, constant across runs against one load, so a same-version re-run writes 0 rows instead of re-stamping every in-range parcel.

write_discipline.scope: full: every parcel with p.geom IS NOT NULL AND ST_IsValid(p.geom) within the proximity radius of a segment; incremental: the same AND p.centreline_dataset_version_when_enriched IS DISTINCT FROM $1; skip: none

invalidates.when: trg_parcels_geom_invalidation (the LDG-10 O2-A fifth-arm migration) NULLs the stamp on ANY write that changes a parcel's geom, which makes a moved parcel stale for the next incremental run; load_parcels' #418 DEC-FENCE2 arm (scripts/load-parcels.descriptor.json, set_null_on_change_of geom) is KEPT as the loader-path fence. An address-only change does NOT re-stale (EC-D3, declared limitation). A load_centreline source_dataset_version change stales every parcel through the mode gate (full mode), not through this column.

why.text: Ported by name from the legacy reduced-mode row (:450); null in full mode (additive, explained diff). Normal (EC-D2): a steady, non-zero stale count on unchanged days is the never-linked out-of-range tail (plus any newly loaded parcels), not churn; it shrinks only when load_parcels adds or moves parcels near a street. invariants.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE (is_corner_lot OR is_through_lot) AND primary_frontage_street_name IS NULL

why.text: Plan Fold A7 (iv): a corner or through lot abuts two NAMED streets (both names NOT NULL), so the frontage resolution always has a candidate. A port error in parcel_frontage or the final SELECT breaks this while every count row stays green. WARN (additive row, never a new FAIL). MEASURED 0 on the local dev DB, 2026-09-30. Fold A7 (iii) is structural in the SQL (new_is_through_lot requires seg_count >= 2) and not table-checkable: parcels stores no segment count.

deviations.from: the legacy skip path, which ran NO precondition at all (legacy :503-507)

why.text: EC-D6 (declared deviation). guards.requires is runner-owned and runs on EVERY invocation, skip included, so a skip run now also refuses a missing extension / index / function / column. The non-empty toronto_centreline probe stays at its legacy POSITION (inside the transaction, full and incremental only — compute assertCentrelineNonEmpty), so the only states that differ are a pathological schema with an unchanged version, which EC-D2 makes unreachable in steady state anyway.

deviations.from: the legacy L21 grading: WARN at zeroPct >= 10, FAIL at zeroPct >= 40 (legacy gradeDiagnosticRows :430)

why.text: EC-D11 (declared deviation, the load_wsib WS-D9 precedent). The check grammar's pct comparator is inclusive (`pct <= N`) and has no strict form, so exactly 10.0 reads PASS (legacy WARN) and exactly 40.0 reads WARN (legacy FAIL). Every other value grades identically. Measured run 1477: 2.99%, far from both edges. Restored when the library gains a strict pct comparator (filed with WS-D9).

deviations.adjudicated_by: Spec 124 §7 rung (b) — declared check/audit-row diff (load_wsib WS-D9 precedent, b0f9d6db)

deviations.from: the legacy audit table shape: 16 rows in full mode, 6 INFO rows + a literal PASS verdict in reduced modes (legacy :447-463, :544-558)

why.text: One declared checks[] list serves every mode: 19 rows. In a reduced mode the 13 full-only rows are reported INERT (render INFO, value 'not measured (mode=…)'), so the row-derived verdict equals the legacy's literal PASS on the same data; EC-D1 (no grading in reduced modes) is CARRIED, not fixed (④a). In full mode the three reduced-only rows (enrich_centreline_mode / _skip_reason / parcels_recomputed) are additive. The WARN-severity diagnostics render PASS (not INFO) when within bound. All explained diffs, recorded in docs/reports/golden/enrich_centreline/explained-diffs.json at capture.

deviations.from: the legacy emitMeta lineage lists (full :592-598; reduced :477-483)

why.text: inputs.reads is authored from the READS EVIDENCE TABLE (assessment §12, operator rule 2026-09-30): every table and column the legacy SQL touches, guard / scope / join / order columns included, so it is WIDER than either legacy emitMeta list (full omitted toronto_centreline.id and feature_code_desc, the five guard-read parcels columns and pipeline_runs; reduced listed three parcels columns). Intentional omissions, each covered elsewhere: logic_variables (the legacy read none; the 19 knobs are resolved by the runner's config.js, not by compute SQL); the catalog probes pg_extension / pg_indexes / information_schema.columns / pg_proc (declared as guards.requires); tmp_centreline_enrich (the step's own session-local temp table, ON COMMIT DROP).

limitations.what: EC-D10 (PINNED KNOWN DEFECT, operator ruling 2026-09-30): the producer contract reads only `pipeline = 'sources:load_centreline' AND status = 'completed'`, ported verbatim. Converted load_centreline STANDALONE runs are ledgered under the bare slug with `completed_with_warnings`, so they are never read: the stamp can name an older version than the one toronto_centreline holds. In-chain runs are unaffected. The fix belongs to the descriptor-truth programme, not this differential-neutral conversion.
limitations.measured: dev DB 2026-09-30: the contract reads run 1471 (80496e67…, 2026-07-08) while toronto_centreline holds run 2132's 47,318 rows (7b86fe74…); a scoped recompute of 2,000 parcels against the current table differed on 0 of 2,000.

limitations.what: EC-D1 (carried, ④a): reduced modes (incremental / skip) never grade — the L21 FAIL gate and the three WARN diagnostics are measured in full mode only; their rows are reported not-measured (INFO) otherwise.
limitations.measured: 7 of 17 consecutive producer transitions changed the version on the dev ledger (2026-06-10 … 09-29), so reduced runs are the unchanged-version days.

limitations.what: EC-D2 (carried, observability only): skip is unreachable in steady state — the never-stamped out-of-range tail keeps countStaleParcels above zero, so an unchanged-version run is incremental.
limitations.measured: 24,426 stale valid-geom parcels 2026-09-30 (16,060 after one absorption run).

limitations.what: EC-D3 (declared limitation, filed): the stale set is not exactly {new, moved, never-linked}. The #418 fence NULLs the stamp only on a geom change, so a changed address_number / street_name_normalized (the P1/P2 frontage inputs) never re-stales primary_frontage_street_name until the next producer version or ENRICH_CENTRELINE_FORCE_FULL.

EC-D4 (carried, ④b): no retraction. A parcel that leaves the proximity radius keeps its corner / through / frontage / laneway values and its NULL or old stamp; it is recomputed every incremental run and never corrected. A fix must NOT stamp it (stamping destroys the legit-NULL tail signal).
limitations.measured: 6 residue parcels 2026-09-30, all out of range, stale frontage names only (ids 26237, 29145, 56782, 242296, 291715, 318769).

limitations.what: EC-D5 (carried, ④c): guards.requires lists the legacy's 4 target columns and omits parcels.abuts_laneway (migration 191 postdates the legacy check).
EC-D9 (carried, filed): the pair cap keeps the first N segments per parcel by centreline id, not by distance — an arbitrary subset for dense parcels.

RV-L2 class — guards.empty_source is DECLARATIVE: the runner has no non-empty probe kind. The real refusal is compute assertCentrelineNonEmpty, kept at the legacy position (inside the transaction, full and incremental only).

recovery.reset: No TRUNCATE/rebuild mechanism and none is needed — NULLing parcels.centreline_dataset_version_when_enriched for a scoped set of parcels makes the next incremental run recompute exactly those; ENRICH_CENTRELINE_FORCE_FULL recomputes every valid-geom parcel.

interrupted_why.text: The single write target sits inside ONE shared transaction (execution.txn_scope 'step', phase txn 'shared'), so a run killed mid-statement leaves parcels exactly as it found them — no half-written state (legacy: the same, one withTransaction). runEnrichPhase folds staleness.detectInterruptedRetraction into `full` before the pass runs, and the pass honours it (mode = ctx.full ? 'full' : contract.mode), so the next run is a full recompute.

before_image_why.text: recovery.before_image applies to a retraction (outputs.writes[].retract != 'none'); this step's sole write target declares retract:'none' — it only ever stamps values, never clears a row (EC-D4).

why.text: A4 ruling (ENRICHER precedent) + plan Fold A8: the population this mode scanned — full: valid-geom parcels; incremental: the stale count the gate measured; skip: 0. The legacy emitted null (explained diff).
This step INSERTs nothing — class N's executor refuses INSERT INTO / ON CONFLICT text. A finite literal 0 rather than the legacy null, because null reads as 'not counted' (explained diff).
COUNTER-ROOT: the rowCount of the sole declared write target, owned by the ctx.joinUpdate seam — one-to-one with the legacy records_updated: rowCount.
Advisory lock 64 held elsewhere. Row-derived SKIP summary (legacy: the withAdvisoryLock SDK SKIP, :487, :604).

The centreline_join phase ran in whichever mode the gate chose (a skip run included — its pass issues no statement) and no row is above PASS/INFO. Load-bearing: enrich_permits' assertCentrelineEnriched HALTs the permits/coa chains unless a COMPLETED enrich_centreline run post-dates the latest parcels load, so a zero-write run must land here, never on a skip terminal.
The phase ran and at least one non-blocking row is WARN (L21's warn tier, a WARN diagnostic, the frontage invariant or a share plausibility row). Row-derived, never a parallel boolean.
L21 FAIL (zero-intersection pct above the fail tier) in a full run — the legacy verdict FAIL from the same row. The write has already committed (the check is post), exactly as the legacy.
